Nebenkosten.es: gastos de comunidad, gastos adicionales (die, plural)

texto: After a defined article (**der**, **die**, **das** and its declined variants), the adjective adopts the so-called weak desinence: **-e** in the four cases of the singular not marked obliquely (masculine: **der neue Mietvertrag** nominee, neutral nominee: **das helle Zimmer**, feminine: **die ruhige Lage** nominee, and feminine and neutral: **die moderne Küche**, **das sonnige Wohnzimmer**).

In all other cases of the table (accentuative masculine, all datives, all genitivos and the whole plural), the invariable termination of the adjective is **-en**: **den neuen Mietvertrag**, **dem freundlichen Vermieter**, **der renovierten Wohnung**, **die hohen Nebenkosten**.

intro: Weak declination of the adjective: when the defined article already clearly marks the gender and the case, the adjective adopts only two possible terminations: **-e** or **-en**.
